resume_model_rationale: Each unit is one candidate file-batch executed together with the victim from a fresh clean pytest process (no prior units' state assumed present). Units are independent probes: a unit's PASS/FAIL outcome and any recorded identity delta depend only on that batch's own files + the victim, not on any other unit having run first in the same process. This differs from the predecessor's continuous single-process execution-time trace (Model C: ~80/571 files in one process, not validly resumable at N+1 without replaying 1..N) -- that trace's zero-delta finding over its covered prefix is preserved as separate non-checkpointed corroborating evidence, not imported as checkpointed unit coverage.
